pages.text: The hatchery: larvae become cocoons, cocoons become units. A drone turns INTO a building.
Creep spreads round hatcheries and tumors; on it zerg run faster and heal. Wild zerg hate every living thing, raid villages and dig tunnels. Glowing flesh and tumors keep monsters from spawning.
Zergling: fast, cheap, in pairs. Becomes a baneling.
Hydralisk: spines at range. Becomes a lurker.
Ultralisk: the heavy blades of the swarm.
